title: BRo-JEPA: Learning Modular Transformations in Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2606.01372v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can neural networks learn algebraic rules from visual inputs, or do they merely fit observed patterns? We study this question using MNIST (or EMNIST letters) as states and modular arithmetic operations as actions in a JEPA-style world model. Standard supervised and JEPA baselines with operation embeddings achieve high accuracy on seen operations but fail to extrapolate reliably to unseen operations. We propose BRo-JEPA, a world model with a block-rotation predictor that represents arithmetic operations as rotations, resulting in the cyclic structure of modular arithmetic in latent space. By applying actions as rotations, the BRo-JEPA predictor learns the rotation angles to align the latent representations with the underlying modular structure which enables strict zero-shot operation generalization. translated_title: BRo-JEPA：在潜在空间中学习模块化变换
translated_abstract: 摘要：神经网络能否从视觉输入中学习代数规则，还是仅仅拟合观察到的模式？我们使用MNIST（或EMNIST字母）作为状态，并以模算术运算作为动作，在JEPA风格的世界模型中研究这一问题。带有运算嵌入的标准监督学习和JEPA基线在已见运算上达到了高准确率，但无法可靠地外推到未见运算。我们提出了BRo-JEPA，一种带有块旋转预测器的世界模型，该模型将算术运算表示为旋转，从而在潜在空间中形成模算术的循环结构。通过将动作应用为旋转，BRo-JEPA预测器学习旋转角度，以将潜在表示与底层模结构对齐，从而实现严格的零样本运算泛化。虽然我们最佳的块旋转监督基线在MNIST上仅达到54.54%的零样本准确率，在EMNIST上为25.13%，但BRo-JEPA在零样本设置下显著优于这些基线。
tldr: 本文提出BRo-JEPA世界模型，通过将算术运算表示为潜在空间中的块旋转，利用模算术的循环结构，实现了对未见运算的严格零样本泛化，显著优于监督基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BRo-JEPA, a world model that represents arithmetic operations as block rotations in latent space, leveraging the cyclic structure of modular arithmetic to achieve strict zero-shot generalization to unseen operations, significantly outperforming supervised baselines.
